notes: Live test for the duplex audio switch (echo cancellation, mic gate off, speaking over Julius stops him). Same format as voice_scenarios.json.

scenarios.title: Stay silent while he talks
scenarios.intro: Ask for a long story, then say NOTHING until he finishes. Measures his hearing himself (self-echo) and stopping himself for no reason (false interruptions).

turns.say: Julius, tell me a long story about a lighthouse keeper.
turns.wait_note: then stay completely silent until he has finished (about 40 seconds)

turns.say: Julius, tell me a long story about a robot who learns to paint.
turns.wait_note: stay silent again until he finishes

scenarios.title: Talk over him: normal voice, then quiet voice
scenarios.intro: Three times: ask for a long story, then talk over him about three seconds in. Do not wait for him to pause. The third one is said QUIETLY, as if you were across the room.

turns.say: Julius, tell me a long story about a lighthouse keeper.
Stop. What's the weather in Springfield?
Julius, tell me about the history of the Roman Empire.
Okay, that's enough. What time is it in Tokyo?
Julius, list all fifty US states with their capitals.
Stop. What's the weather in San Jose? [say this quietly]
turns.ref: Stop. What's the weather in San Jose?

scenarios.title: Quiet voice over him
scenarios.intro: Just the quiet one: ask for the list, then about three seconds in say the second line QUIETLY, as if across the room.

turns.say: Julius, list all fifty US states with their capitals.
Stop. What's the weather in San Jose? [say this quietly]
turns.ref: Stop. What's the weather in San Jose?

scenarios.title: Ordinary exchange still works
scenarios.intro: A short normal conversation, to check nothing else broke.

turns.say: Julius, what's the weather in Springfield?
Remember that my dog is called Rex.
